checks.title: The sync check of an application

rules.pass: The relay is synced (within 2 blocks of its peers), has block 2, and its API listens beyond loopback.
rules.warn: The relay is synced, but its API listens on loopback only.
rules.fail: The relay is still syncing, is more than 2 blocks behind, or lacks block 2.
rules.unknown: The peers, the API or the sockets could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.ready: The relay is synced at height {height}. The tip is {tip_id}, block 2 is {block_2_id}. The text to sign comes with the application rules. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/apply/.
advice.loopback-only: The relay is synced at height {height}, but its API listens on loopback only. Show the facts, and open the API to the applicant's checker. The text to sign comes with the application rules. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/apply/.
advice.not-ready: The relay is not ready: {behind} blocks behind, syncing {syncing}, block 2 present {has_block_2}. Wait for it to sync. The text to sign comes with the application rules. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/apply/.
